name: typescript
title: TypeScript (React, Next.js, TanStack)
applies: A repository with one package.json, a tsconfig.json and a lockfile of npm or pnpm in its root. Tests run with vitest.

rules.rule: No lint errors and no warnings: the strict, type-aware rules of typescript-eslint, the rules of React, of React hooks and of accessibility (jsx-a11y), and the rules of SonarJS. No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no unused lint exceptions.
A framework that the project uses brings its own rules: Next.js (including Core Web Vitals), TanStack Query and TanStack Router. Using the framework without its lint plugin fails the lint.
No insecure code patterns, such as eval, unsafe regular expressions or child processes built from input.
A file has at most 400 lines, a function at most 80 lines, at most 5 parameters and 4 levels of nesting, and a complexity of at most 15.
enforced_by: eslint max-lines, max-lines-per-function, max-params, max-depth, complexity

rules.rule: The project type-checks in strict mode, whatever tsconfig.json says, and an indexed access may be undefined.
All tests pass, and there is at least one.
The tests cover at least 80% of the lines of all TypeScript source files, including files that no test imports.
The installed packages are exactly those of the lockfile, and none has a known vulnerability of high or critical severity.

enforced_by: the secret scan of the Maestro service

rules.rule: The agent cannot change these rules, the scripts that check them, or the CI workflows.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (protected paths)

image: RUN npm install --global --no-fund --no-audit pnpm@10 && npm cache clean --force
after_apply: npm install --save-dev --save-exact eslint@9 @eslint/js@9 typescript@6.0 typescript-eslint eslint-plugin-react eslint-plugin-react-hooks eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y eslint-plugin-sonarjs eslint-plugin-security globals prettier vitest @vitest/coverage-v8
If the project uses Next.js, also: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @next/eslint-plugin-next
If it uses TanStack Query or Router, also: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @tanstack/eslint-plugin-query @tanstack/eslint-plugin-router
With pnpm, use `pnpm add --save-dev --save-exact` and the same package names.
npx prettier --write .    (once, so that existing files pass the format rule)
